rounds.text: Venus Remedies is currently undergoing a fundamental transformation, evidenced by a dramatic acceleration in performance where trailing twelve-month profit growth has surged to 149% [E21] and sales growth to 20% [E17]. This operational momentum is supported by a significant expansion in efficiency, with operating margins rising by 10 percentage points over the last three years [E30] and a robust ROCE of 20.7% that comfortably outpaces the sector benchmark of 12% [E10, E12]. The company’s financial health is exceptionally strong, characterized by a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02x [E38] and a cash conversion ratio of 1.51x, ensuring that reported profits are fully backed by actual cash flow [E34]. Furthermore, the business is actively investing in its future, as seen in the 96.2% increase in capital work-in-progress [E41]. Conceded: the stock is trading at 3.62 times its book value [E63], and institutional money flow has recently turned negative [E45]. Despite these concerns, the company’s intrinsic value, as calculated by a discounted cash flow model, suggests a substantial margin of safety of 49.2% [E46, E47].
